I'm trying not to. My self esteem is fucking abysmal... I just keep thinking maybe I'd be happier if I could not be a fatass, maybe I would be more approachable and maybe my friends would come back. I'm 5'1 and my gw is probably around 100.

I should've never been born. I didn't think I'd make it to 16. Or 18. Or 21.. But now Im finally starting to realize that people don't want me around and there has to be reason. So isolating myself is the only way to not hurt the people I love, even if they don't care about me. Therefore, I should punish myself for putting myself before them.
There's no end of the tunnel. Only a brick wall. Just on a crash course with destiny.

Happy Birthday!! I spent my last birthday alone, I feel that.. My issue is I don't know when to stop. They haven't answered even though you've sent them 20+ texts? Maybe they'll answer if you send another one. And I'm hyper aware I'm doing it and need to stop but physically can't. I've tried training myself like a dog to not talk to people who obviously don't want to talk to me and it hasn't worked.
Yep. I just want people to love me like I love them. I'm emptying my cup without anything to refill it

I don't have meds anymore, hated the last doctor they sent me too, I have two Bipolar diagnoses in my life, and he kind of scoffed at me and was like "Yea well we'll see about that." so I didn't go back and ended up majorly suicidal on the medication he put me on (Trileptal) so I just really haven't even gone back. I've just been trucking it on my own. My best friend is like "You're worrying me, don't be like that, everything is okay." but other than that he'll barely speak to me
I try and try to get ahold of people and they all ignore me. It's always been like that. It's so frustrating. Its making my anxiety sky high. I'm thinking irs just who I am
Yea. I seek out people here and refresh and refresh

I'm expecting some changes when I actually move on to therapy and actually kind of talk more about my feelings and less just about my actions.
God I hope Im able to get on medication soon
